title: Extract Action Input Into Search Pane And Categorize Actions
description:
Extract the window's typed action input line out of the top-left Engagement overlay into a new top-middle Search window pane with its own fold toggle, positioned between the Engagement (actions, top-left) and Measures (options, top-right) overlays. Group the bottom-right WindowActionPane's actions into categories like commands, rendering arg inputs inline as UI elements the same way utilities/commands do.

Scope: ui/js/react/index.tsx (Engagement/Search split, new WindowSearchChrome, Window overlay wiring, i18n), framework/renderer/react/index.tsx + index.test.ts (shell plumbing windowEngagementToSpec split, WindowActionPane category tree), cad/renderer/js/index.tsx (EngagementSpec consumer split), storybook stories, framework/product/os/dev/script.ts e2e selector update. No backwards compatibility, clean rename/split per greenfield rules.
